cause: The ported PDType1CFont.GetStringWidth now consults the CFF charstring width. CFFParser.ReadType1Private preserves parsed DICT operands as List<float>, but CFFType1Font.TryNumber recognized only scalar int/float/double; nominalWidthX=650 was ignored. The space charstring delta -511 yielded negative width; PDFont.GetSpaceWidth then fell back to code32 width490 and text extraction dropped inferred word spaces.
fix: Recognize exactly one numeric float operand in parsed CFF DICT lists when reading defaultWidthX and nominalWidthX; preserve public dictionary representation and existing scalar input handling.
